title: Tints, shades and tones of a colour
examples: What is the difference between a tint and a shade?
How do I make a colour lighter?
What is a tone in art?

groups.ask: What is a shade in art?

explain.say: Is pink a new colour, or is it secretly red? It is red in disguise! Add white, black or grey to any colour and you get a whole family of new ones. Look at the board: three groups, tints, shades and tones.

draw.text: Tints, shades and tones of a colour

groups.label: Shades: + black
groups.ask: What is a shade in art?

groups.label: Tones: + grey
groups.ask: What is a tone in art?

explain.say: Look at the first group, tints. A tint is a colour with white added. Red plus white is pink; blue plus white is sky blue. Tints feel light and soft. What tint would you get from purple?

groups.label: Shades: + black
groups.ask: What is a shade in art?

groups.label: Tones: + grey
groups.ask: What is a tone in art?

explain.say: Now look at the shades. A shade is a colour with black added. Red plus black is maroon; blue plus black is navy. Shades feel deep and serious. Which shade might you see on a school uniform?

groups.label: Shades: + black
groups.ask: What is a shade in art?

groups.label: Tones: + grey
groups.ask: What is a tone in art?

explain.say: The last group is tones. A tone is a colour with grey added, so it gets softer and less bright, like sage green or dusty pink. Interior designers love tones for calm rooms. Can you see why they look gentle?

groups.label: Shades: + black
groups.ask: What is a shade in art?

groups.label: Tones: + grey
groups.ask: What is a tone in art?

explain.say: Brilliant! Now try a value scale, which means a row of boxes from light to dark. Look at the board and tick off the steps as you go. Wow fact: with just one tube of blue plus black and white, you can paint a whole sea, from the foamy waves to the deep water.

steps.label: Draw 5 boxes
steps.note: A row of squares, side by side

steps.label: Paint pure colour
steps.note: Fill the middle box with the colour

steps.label: Add white bit by bit
steps.note: Fill the boxes to the left, lighter each time

steps.label: Add black bit by bit
steps.note: Fill the boxes to the right, darker each time

faq.a: A tint is a colour mixed with white, which makes it lighter. Pink is a tint of red, and sky blue is a tint of blue.
asks: How do I make a colour lighter?

faq.q: What is a shade in art?
faq.a: A shade is a colour mixed with black, which makes it darker. Maroon is a shade of red, and navy is a shade of blue.
asks: How do I make a colour darker?
Is navy a shade of blue?

faq.q: What is a tone in art?
faq.a: A tone is a colour mixed with grey. It is less bright and more muted, like sage green or slate blue.
asks: How do I make a colour duller?

faq.q: What is the difference between a tint and a shade?
faq.a: A tint adds white to make a colour lighter; a shade adds black to make it darker.
A value scale is a row of boxes showing one colour, or grey, from very light to very dark. Artists use it to practise and to plan light and shadow.
asks: What does value mean in art?
How do I make a tonal scale?

facts: In colour theory, a tint adds white, a shade adds black and a tone adds grey to a colour.
Value means how light or dark a colour is.

quiz.say: You add white to red paint. What do you get?
quiz.why: Adding white makes a tint, and a tint of red is pink.

wrong.1: A shade needs black, not white.
wrong.2: A tone needs grey, not white.

quiz.say: Navy blue is blue with black added. What is navy?

wrong.1: A tint adds white and makes it lighter.
wrong.2: Navy is mixed, so it is not a primary colour.
